caption:
Credit card balances just hit a record $1.29 trillion. 💳

The New York Fed says that's up about 4% from a year ago. At the same time, Money Management International reports its busiest two months for debt management plan sign-ups since early 2011.

Big numbers, real people behind them.

Are you seeing more people around you struggle with card balances?
